definitions.episode_scope: completed episodes, including failed episodes; no active episode imputation
definitions.windows: 1-based PPO collection update index; stochastic policy evolving within each window
definitions.candidate_contact: loaded-body geometric proxy, not calibrated string pressure or sound
definitions.transition_rewards: all committed control transitions including unfinished episodes; weights already applied
definitions.finger_motion: 60Hz per-episode means/ranges; not 240Hz extrema; initial settling included
definitions.thumb_proximity_warning: legacy rear distance is not strict target-region contact; use thumb_support
definitions.extrema: predefined diagnostic shape patterns, not a proof of all unnatural postures
definitions.audible_wrong_source: summed source-tagged audible note-seconds; simultaneous bodies/causes/targets can overlap, do not add to union wrong duration
